_comment: The night's DJ lineup. Read by the VJ rig's web remote (/schedule) and
published to GitHub Pages alongside Whitelist.json so the in-world side
can read it the same way.
Lineup order IS running order -- it is never sorted, because a lineup
that crosses midnight (23:00 -> 00:00) does not sort.
times are LOCAL wall-clock at the venue, "HH:MM", no timezone.
Event.date: leave EMPTY for a rolling weekly event (the rig anchors the
lineup on tonight); set "YYYY-MM-DD" to pin it to one night.
Event.slot_minutes: countdown fallback when a set time is missing or for
the last slot; otherwise the gap to the next set time wins.
vrc    = the DJ VRChat username (matches the Whitelist.json DJ group)
stream = a VRCDN name, or any full stream URL
